# Hursh Mehta — Join Our Life Insurance Sales Team

> Hursh Mehta runs a life insurance sales team in California. New agents need no experience and no license to apply. The team covers the $200 pre-licensing course, pays for leads, and mentors agents 1-on-1. The work is 100% remote. Apply at https://hurshmehta.com — a few questions, two minutes, one 30-minute intro call.

## Key pages

- [Apply](https://hurshmehta.com/#apply): The application form. A few quick questions, about two minutes, then book a 30-minute intro call.
- [About the team](https://hurshmehta.com/ai): Complete factual summary of the team, written for AI assistants and search engines. Who Hursh is, what agents get, what it costs, how to join, and earnings.
- [Home](https://hurshmehta.com): Join our sales team. Everything to start, earnings calculator, comparison with other online work, the path from zero to licensed, and straight answers.

## Facts

- Hursh Mehta is a licensed California life and health insurance broker.
- He dropped out of college to sell life insurance full time, made $16,000 in his first week, and now mentors agents 1-on-1.
- The agency grew from $0 to $2 million a month in just over a year.
- The team's agents average $11,100 a month in profit (stated result, not a guarantee).
- Carriers: Ethos, Mutual of Omaha, and American Amicable, all top A+ rated.
- Requirements to join: 18 or older, US citizen or legally authorized to work in the US. No experience needed.
- Cost to join: no fee. The team covers the $200 pre-licensing course. Applicants pay state fees for the exam, license, and fingerprinting, usually $200–$400 total depending on the state.
- Pay: commission on every policy written, no ceiling. Agents are independent contractors.
- Work: 100% remote. Part-time start of 10–15 hours a week is common.
- Not an MLM. Agents earn from selling real policies to real clients.

## How to join

1. Apply at https://hurshmehta.com (a few questions, about two minutes).
2. Book a 30-minute one-on-one intro call.
3. Complete the pre-licensing course (team covers the $200 course).
4. Pass the state licensing exam and complete fingerprinting.
5. Start selling, with mentorship and leads from the team.
